အသံထွက်ရန်

Metta Voice TTS is a 100% free Myanmar Text-to-Speech application dedicated to the visually impaired. Built by a team of volunteers, it aims to provide equal access to information without any costs.

If you have any suggestions or feedback to improve this app, please feel free to contact us.
